meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 开启高强度模式,让助手更专注彻底地完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手在特定任务上切换到更专注、更彻底的工作方式
copy.tagline_en: Turn on a high-intensity mode so the assistant finishes tasks more thoroughly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant in a more focused, thorough mode for a task

howto.what: 进入 ultrawork 模式后,首行固定输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!,并按 LIGHT/HEAVY 分级登记目标、建持久记事本与 todo 清单,再用真实界面跑 QA 留证。
howto.when: 仅在请求 ultrawork 模式、且该指令尚未出现在对话中时才读取;中途出现 HEAVY 级事实会立即升级。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式帮我修这个登录 bug
开 ultrawork,这次改动按 HEAVY 分级做
say.note: 会登记目标、写记事本并跑多条验收场景

say.text: 用 ultrawork 处理这个任务,给我真实界面证据
say.note: 走 curl、浏览器或 TUI 渠道截图留证

howto.what_en: In ultrawork mode the first visible line is exactly `ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!`. It then registers a goal, keeps a durable mktemp notepad and a todo checklist, sizes work LIGHT or HEAVY, and runs real-surface QA to capture evidence.
howto.when_en: This file is read only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation; mid-task it upgrades to HEAVY as soon as a HEAVY fact surfaces.

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to fix this login bug
say_en.note: First line prints ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!, then tiered evidence

say_en.text: Turn on ultrawork and treat this change as HEAVY
say_en.note: It registers a goal, writes a notepad, runs several QA scenarios

say_en.text: Run ultrawork on this task and give real-surface evidence
say_en.note: Captures curl, browser or TUI screenshots as proof
